about: Work in progress. Popular Massive presets from PresetShare, each rendered from its own MIDI demo in Massive and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, same tempo, no normalization. MIDI cut at 30 s.

patches.title: AND-Bass-Sub-15
notes: osc_2: filter 1/2 balance +5.0 dB can't be kept
mod osc position modulation not converted
insert 2 S Shaper not converted
insert S Shaper: global Vital distortion (Massive's is per voice)
feedback 0.42 approximated by distortion drive (Vital has no feedback loop)
not converted: MOD.OSC-PITCH, MOD.OSC-POSITION, NOISE-COLOR
